detail.longDescription: I recently switched from Windows 11 to Linux Mint and was setting up a virtual environment ( venv ) for a personal project. Everything else is working as expected, but I'm unable to install PyTorch. When I run pip install torch , the download repeatedly gets interrupted and eventually fails with an incomplete-download error.
